t: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
For I know the plans I have for you — plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
But those who wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.
The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.
Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
Commit your works to the Lord, and your plans will be established.
No weapon formed against you shall prosper.
Be still, and know that I am God.
With God all things are possible.
The Lord your God is in your midst, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over you with gladness.
For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.
Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
God doesn't call the equipped. He equips the called.
You are not defined by your past. You are prepared by it.
Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.
Let your faith be bigger than your fear.
The will of God will never take you where the grace of God cannot keep you.
God's plan is always better than our own.
Your hardest times often lead to the greatest moments of your life. Keep going. Tough situations build strong people.
Character is doing the right thing when nobody's looking.
You may have to fight a battle more than once to win it.
God is within her, she will not fall.
Prayer is not asking. It is a longing of the soul.
The secret of change is to focus all of your energy not on fighting the old but on building the new.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
Push yourself, because no one else is going to do it for you.
Great things never come from comfort zones.
Don't stop when you're tired. Stop when you're done.
Wake up with determination. Go to bed with satisfaction.
Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
It's going to be hard, but hard is not impossible.
You didn't come this far to only come this far.
Work hard in silence. Let your success be the noise.
Success is the sum of small efforts repeated day in and day out.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
You are one decision away from a completely different life.
If you want to change your life, start with changing your habits.
Small steps every day. Big results over time.
Every expert was once a beginner.
The harder you work for something, the greater you'll feel when you achieve it.
Success doesn't just find you. You have to go out and get it.
Believe in yourself and all that you are. Know that there is something inside you that is greater than any obstacle.
The key to success is to focus on goals, not obstacles.
The best way to predict the future is to create it.
You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity.
It always seems impossible until it's done.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
Turn your wounds into wisdom.
Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
Happiness is not something ready-made. It comes from your own actions.
The best revenge is massive success.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.
Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap but by the seeds that you plant.
The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
Life is not measured by the number of breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away.
I have learned over the years that when one's mind is made up, this diminishes fear.
You must be the change you wish to see in the world.
In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: it goes on.
You cannot change your destination overnight, but you can change your direction overnight.
The quality of your life is determined by the quality of your habits.
Pain is temporary. Pride is forever.
Eat well. Sleep well. Move daily. Think clearly. The rest follows.
Today's actions are tomorrow's results.
Success is not final; failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
The most valuable thing you can make is a mistake — you can't learn anything from being perfect.
Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.
You get in life what you have the courage to ask for.
An unexamined life is not worth living.
The most common form of despair is not being who you are.
Life is short, and it's up to you to make it sweet.
We know what we are, but know not what we may be.
A year from now you may wish you had started today.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
